decision: Continue a bounded matched-material study; do not scale training or claim CVPR-level evidence yet.
scientific_question: With the same sourced knowledge and actions, does learning their state-specific correspondence improve complete-room functional outcomes or cost beyond separate learning, retrieval and ordinary feedback?

three_evidence_levels.knowledge: Attribution establishes a sourced principle, not its correctness in every reconstructed scene.
three_evidence_levels.rationale_action_fidelity: An honest intended explanation can be paired with an executed action without proving that the action improves the design.
three_evidence_levels.outcome_utility: Measured effects must be attributed to the correct phase and task; execution success and whole-room quality remain different targets.

objective.X: Identical pre-action state, task, other-project knowledge and tool interface
objective.D: Source-supported, researcher-reconstructed state-specific decision; generated by the policy at deployment
objective.control: Same source units, target token weighting, initial weights, update count, tool permissions and inference budget; disclose compute differences
objective.novelty: Standard conditional likelihood; not a new loss or a theorem of improved design.

reason_error_identity.definition: Let E mean the generated decision is not appropriate to the current task/state; B mean the resulting action is bad under the scoped evaluator. eps=P(E), delta=P(B|not E), eta=P(B|E).
reason_error_identity.identity: P(B)=(1-eps)*delta+eps*eta, with positive-probability conditioning events; degenerate events contribute zero.
reason_error_identity.assumptions: Law of total probability; no independence assumption and no fitted parameters here.
reason_error_identity.implication: Lower teacher-forced action loss with a supplied reason does not establish low eps or eta, nor a lower bad-action probability than the separate model.
reason_error_identity.measure: Free-running generated reasons and complete trajectories on independent project families; teacher-forced prefixes only as diagnostic.

compression_invariance.exact: For fixed task u and deterministic terminal checker phi, identical full checker inputs imply identical phi_u outputs. Endpoint-preserving trajectory compression can reduce actions, not turn the same failed endpoint into a passing endpoint.
compression_invariance.tolerance: Pose consistency within 3 cm/3 degrees does not imply identical thresholded functional predicates; verify them separately.
compression_invariance.history: A changed retained input invalidates reuse of its original image/memory/feedback unless matched or recomputed. Even exact poses alone do not prove all multimodal context is unchanged.
compression_invariance.scope: These are mathematical/engineering boundaries, not a novel planning mechanism.

controls: Frozen backbone with sufficient task prompt and the same knowledge
Ordinary retrieval with the same knowledge
Ordinary geometric/activity feedback and bounded search
Same-material separate supervision versus correctly paired supervision as primary contrast
before_gpu: Reconcile the 920 LEARN final receipt: Git currently has only a dated start snapshot
Recover exact original multimodal inputs or explicitly version a replacement dataset, without silent substitutions
Select sourced state-specific decisions across independent project families and verify phase outcomes
Use per-instance and per-pair consequences, and identical bounded joint-edit rules for every method
continue_if: Independent complete-room tasks show repeatable gains in requirements or cost without damage to retained requirements, beyond the ordinary and same-material controls.
revise_if: Only format or stopping improves; retrieval/geometry accounts for the gains; correct outcomes require supplied gold reasons; or gains remain confined to training-exposed projects.
